messages:
mike_c: Quick sync — thinking we need to tweak region-aware routing to consider customer tier + model variant fallback costs. Not just latency.
anya: +1. Can you sketch the high-level rule? e.g., prefer same-region for premium, otherwise latency threshold? :thinking_face:
mike_c: Exactly. Proposal: 1) premium customers: strict region affinity (failover only if "region unreachable"). 2) standard: prefer low-latency region within 100ms, else fallback to best-cost variant in any region. 3) free/tiered: cost-first routing with >200ms cap.
jonathan: How do we measure "region unreachable"? health probes + request error rates? Also cache warmness for KV affects latency.
liz_sre: Use rolling probe window + circuit breaker. If 5xx rate > 1% and p95 latency spike > 2x baseline, mark degraded. That signals canary fallback.
priya_pd: UX ask: Console should show active routing decision per request sample row — region chosen, reason (affinity|latency|quota|fallback), and model variant id.
mike_c: Agree. Telemetry: per-request tags: customer_tier, orig_region, selected_region, selected_variant, probe_signals, decision_reason.
anya: For model variants, we need a compatibility map: model A quantized-v1 is acceptable for customers with "cost_relaxed" policy, otherwise stick to baseline.
jonathan: How to express policy? Suggest small DSL in route config, e.g.:
```
route_policy:
  - tier: premium
    affinity: hard
  - tier: standard
    latency_threshold_ms: 100
    allow_variant_fallback: true
```
anya: That DSL looks fine. Need guards for version compatibility and output-quality monitoring. If a variant fallback is used >X% we trigger an eval alert.
liz_sre: Also need circuit hysteresis so we don't oscillate across regions. Add cooldown 10s + exponential backoff.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service@staging v2026.02.13-rc
mike_c: Implementation notes: router will consult (1) customer tier policy, (2) region health map, (3) latency probes, (4) model compatibility table, then evaluate rules in that order.
priya_pd: For dashboards: add a per-tenant route-heatmap and a fallback-rate metric broken down by variant and region.
jonathan: Will we expose an API for partners to pin region? e.g., tenant-level override? That should be admin-only.
anya: admin override yes, with audit log. And a "soft-pin" option that prefers but can be overridden on severe degradation.
mike_c: Action items: anya to draft DSL PR + config schema; jonathan to mock telemetry tags and schema; liz to define probe thresholds; priya to wire up dashboard mockups. I'll run an experiment in staging with 10 tenants.
priya_pd: tagging demo tenants now. thanks.
mike_c: thx all — sync later this week. :rocket:
